_notes: THE FLIGHT LOOP, ALONE. earth_core_6f.png is 1536x1024 over 3x2 and divides
exactly into 512px cells. No rects, no canvas, no scale steps.
MEASURED: a packed, forward-pointing rock arrowhead, ink coverage 24.5-25.0%
of the cell -- roughly double fire's and water's core ink density, which
reads as intended: a dense rigid mass rather than a wispy glow. None of the
six bboxes touch a cell edge.
LOOP SEAM: all six frames are near-identical rock silhouettes -- the same
arrowhead, the same crack lines, only the rim-light and shading shifting
frame to frame. The cleanest loop candidate of the four packs by a wide
margin, because there is almost no pose change to create a seam; the risk
runs the other way -- six frames this similar read as a held pose rather than
a loop unless played fast enough to sell the shimmer in the rim light.
ALPHA: mostly binary like fire's and water's (73.3% at 0, 24.8% above 128,
only 0.4% in the 8-127 middle band) -- a hard edge, not a soft halo.
Delivered with its own alpha; keyed is false.
